name: artist
description: an Artist (Fall from Heaven), a travelling bard: a moustached young man with brown hair under a floppy red beret with a gold band and a big white feather plume, a long red robe-coat with wide sleeves and yellow-gold collar, trim and cuffs, white shirt cuffs, a small brown leather pouch at his hip, brown boots, and a wooden lute with a round golden-brown body and a dark neck held across his chest, its neck gripped in his LEFT hand
hands: the lute's neck stays gripped in his left hand on the screen-right side; at rest his right hand on the screen-left side strums the lute's round body, and during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the right hand lets go of the lute and the left hand lifts the lute by its neck up over the head, its round body pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the lute cocked behind the head by its neck with its round body hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the left arm sweeps over the head and the lute swings level like a club, its round body pointing to the lower-right, the empty right fist out to the side
strike.4: contact: lute arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the lute's round body smashing down-right like a club, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the lute carries on down until its round body nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the beret's white feather trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the lute comes back across the chest held by its neck in the left hand, the right hand reaching back toward its round body

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the left hand jerked up still gripping the lute's neck, the lute held against his chest), the beret's white feather bouncing
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the lute jerked up by its neck with its round body tipping back beside his head, the empty right fist still held out to the left
flinch.2: recovering: halfway back to the ready pose, the lute coming back across his chest, held by its neck in the left hand

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the left arm flung up holding the lute by its neck above his head, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the bereted head droops, the lute held out to the right by its neck, lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the lute's round body resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the lute slips out of the left hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the red beret with its white feather still on his head; the lute lies on the ground at the lower-right; the red robe-coat spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the beret's feather and the robe-coat settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the lute on the ground beside him
